positions.title: Software Engineer - QA
positions.description:
•   Wrote unit and integration tests to validate and train model output using tools such as VS Code, Zed, Codex, and Claude Code, Openclaw, and Ollama

•   Designed and wrote adversarial test prompts that exposed logic errors and unsafe patterns in frontier code-generation models

•   Tested, reviewed, and ensured the quality of applications, algorithms, and systems written by AI models

positions.title: Web Developer & Accessibility Specialist (Temporary)
positions.description:
Oregon Department of Justice

•   Remediated WCAG AA 2.1 violations in PHP and CSS in WordPress theme(s) for main portal and subsites

•   Rebuilt complex legacy UI components (meganav, advanced search, automatic translation) from ground up to enable support for accessibility and legal requirements.

•   Manually audited and tested user experience across screen readers, browsers, and operating systems using tools such as Axe, WAVE, NVDA, Jaws, and VoiceOver

•   Coordinated with internal teams to deploy fixes.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · WCAG Compliance · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · Wordpress Development

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
• ​ ​ Managed websites and applications for local businesses and non-profits, providing ongoing hosting, server management, consultation, design and development services

• ​ ​ Performed server maintenance and setup, including DNS, e-mail hosting, SSL, and ensuring WCAG and PCI-DSS compliance; maintained SQL databases

• ​ ​ Wrote custom WordPress themes and plugins in PHP, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · Software Development · Wordpress Development · Server Management · SQL

positions.title: Front-end Developer and UX Designer
positions.description:
Oregon e-Government Program (Oregon.gov)

• ​ ​ Built a custom CMS platform based in SharePoint and C#/.NET/TypeScript used by 150+ Oregon agencies

• ​ ​ Created a drag-and-drop contact form builder in .NET and TypeScript, along with a suite of custom widgets including a calendar, map, news slider, and more.

• ​ ​ Developed workflows, PowerShell scripts, and custom CLI tools to automate SharePoint deployments and improve statewide standardization across sites.

• ​ ​ Rebuilt Oregon.gov portal search to be more efficient, more relevant, and to process requests in a fraction of the time, eliminating thousands of dollars in annual API costs.

• ​ ​ Built software that helped to ultimately eliminate >95% of statewide issues identified in accessibility reports to improve ADA compliance.

• ​ ​ Worked directly with state agencies and stakeholders, including with the Governor’s Office, ODOT, DOR, DOE, ODA, and more; to gather requirements and/or feedback, offer guidance on design and content architecture.

• ​ ​ Helped in the redesign and migration of several high-volume agency sites, helping them move off legacy technologies and improve usability and accessibility.

• ​ ​ Played a key role in implementing Agile processes, working closely with product owners to prioritize backlogs and document features, codebases, and bi-weekly releases.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · .NET · Incident Response · Web Applications · TypeScript · Front-end Development · WCAG Compliance · Microsoft SQL Server · Help Desk Support · Software Development · State Government · Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
•   Designed and built custom websites and applications for local clients in WordPress, .NET Core, Webflow, and Shopify using PHP, C#, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and more.

• ​ ​ Worked directly with clients across healthcare, hospitality, telecom, and non-profit sectors to create proposals, gather requirements, compile reports, and manage project timelines and priorities.

• ​ ​ Instituted new design and development processes, wrote documentation, trained and mentored junior designers and developers.

positions.title: Owner, Designer and Developer
positions.description:
• ​ ​ Owned and operated a small design studio that delivered marketing services to a variety of businesses locally and remotely
• ​ ​ Built and maintained custom websites in WordPress

positions.title: Designer and Developer
positions.description:
• ​ ​ Built custom websites in Wordpress, Instapage, and other CMSs

• ​ ​ Designed marketing campaign materials for print and web

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description: Designed all print materials for 27 senior living communities throughout the Pacific Northwest and helped maintain the look and feel of the Bonaventure brand.

positions.title: Graphic Designer and Web Developer
positions.description: Designed for print and web for a variety of clients, including Corban University, United Way of the Mid-Willamette valley, and others.

positions.title: IT Specialist and Graphic Designer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained several websites in PHP, HTML/CSS, JavaScript
- Designed materials for web, print, video, etc.
- Served as network administrator and IT support; managed and operated audio/video equipment.
